name: buildings
note_zh: 临时示意几何。总体设计范围与三处重点区直接采用主办方场地包 provisional_boundaries.geojson 的临时替代边界；其余图层为本方案在该边界内的概念设计建议。全部要素 official_boundary=false，不得作为法定红线、审批依据或精确面积复算依据。；建筑以街坊组团体量表达，全部落在可建设用地内；层数为概念假设
note_en: Provisional schematic geometry. The overall design area and the three key areas reuse the organizer's provisional_boundaries.geojson polygons verbatim; all other layers are this proposal's conceptual design inside that boundary. Every feature has official_boundary=false and must not be used as a statutory redline, approval basis, or precise area source. Buildings are block-group envelopes inside developable parcels; storeys are conceptual.
